findings.text: follow-on: _IMAGE_SUFFIXES duplicates the repository's image/figure-suffix capability already owned by reckon/path_classes.py:24 FIGURE_SUFFIXES (and repeated at reckon/metadata_index.py:74, reckon/serve.py:1268) without extending or referencing any of them, so a fifth suffix set can drift from the others; the set legitimately differs (images-only, no .pdf/.mp4), which is why this is a follow-on rather than a block.

justifications.fit: the module keeps the surrounding style of tests/test_spa_owed_captures.py:591-660, imports Callable from collections.abc, names the new test by mechanism, and carries no plan, ticket or version token.

VERDICT done_when: the done_when names tests/test_spa_owed_captures.py running with no teardown error and an image opened inside the window still tripping the guard; head_plain.log records 8 passed EXIT=0 and negative_control.log records the PNG open under the guard failing that id EXIT=1.
VERDICT write_paths: read the manifest's declared paths (tests/test_spa_owed_captures.py, docs/evidence/fragments/the-suite-is-green-at-head/image-guard-catches-only-images.html, and a figures dir); the diff touches the first and the second and no path outside them.
VERDICT manifest: read; it records the gate command and 8 passed EXIT=0 at head 243702994, the base reproduction (base_repro.log 1 passed 1 error EXIT=1) at 40186023d, the collision arm passing, and the negative control.
